title: AID Test Portfolio Audit — Implementation Plan Brief
$comment: producer: aid-test-audit-consolidate.sh (Step 14), consumers: [aid-test-audit-write-plan-bridge.sh (Step 16), the generated remediation plan (Step 22)]
description: Produced only when at least one Medium+/actionable finding exists in consolidated-findings.json — an all-clean findings set produces NO brief file at all (Step 16's validator treats file absence as the clean case). generated_from_hash lets Step 16 detect a STALE brief (derived from an older consolidated-findings.json than the one currently on disk), separate from its own stale-run_unit_id check against a live catalog.

verdict.description: A brief is only ever produced for the 'remediation recommended' verdict — 'clean' never has actionable items to brief, and 'needs measurement' is about insufficient data, not actionable findings. Step 15 independently (re-)computes the authoritative verdict shown in chat directly from consolidated-findings.json; this field is a consistent restatement, not a second source of truth.

proposal.description: A concrete remediation proposal. Not a label — the change names the file:line and the exact edit, the benefit says how it was obtained (and 'unknown' is a normal answer), and the effort is counted facts, never invented hours. Analysts that cannot fill these honestly must omit the proposal rather than decorate a guess.

change.description: The exact edit, naming file:line — 'test-aid-fsm.bats:359 writes $TEST_PROJECT_ROOT/.aid-o under a fixed path; allocate a per-test temp dir instead'. Never 'improve isolation'.

bucket.description: S: single file, mechanical. M: multiple files or a new fixture/helper. L: test architecture, gate config, or production code. decision-required: a human must rule on intent (delete, merge, coverage adequacy).

verify_bucket.description: Effort to VERIFY the change did not lose anything — split from the edit itself, because most delete proposals are S to perform and L to verify, and the verification cost is what decides whether it is worth doing.

repeat_count.description: How many sites the same mechanical change applies to. 'S x 14 sites' is more truthful than 'M'.

facts.description: The countable facts that produced the bucket: files touched, production code changed y/n, new helper needed y/n.

kind.description: measured: from this run's own timings/pilot. extrapolated: measured on a sample and scaled — name both. estimated: from a stated model. unknown: emit no number at all. An audit that never says unknown is not measuring.

critical_path_ms.description: Seconds saved on the CRITICAL PATH, not summed CPU — saving 30s beside a 5-minute serial test saves nothing. Null unless kind supports a number.

risk_note.description: What newly goes undetected (for remove/merge) or newly becomes detected (for add/strengthen). The only unit available where time is not the point.

conflicts_with.description: finding_ids/proposal_ids this proposal contradicts — 'share the setup' contradicts 'isolate per test'. Emit the conflict; never both sides as independent advice.

generated_from_hash.description: sha256 of the exact consolidated-findings.json bytes this brief was derived from.
